title: Benchmark comparison context
responsibility: Identifies a benchmark’s full request and records the invocation boundary and sampling protocol needed for valid comparisons.

inputs.name: requestDigest.request
inputs.description: Complete JSON-shaped request, including operation and input, to fingerprint with canonical serialization.

inputs.name: comparisonContext.request
inputs.description: Complete JSON-shaped request actually sent by the benchmark.

inputs.name: comparisonContext.sampling
inputs.description: Round count and calls per round used by the benchmark; this helper copies rather than validates them.

outputs.name: requestDigest
outputs.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest of canonical request JSON, independent of object-key order.

outputs.name: comparisonContext
outputs.description: Context containing the request digest, public-invocation boundary, harness-rounds/1 protocol and sampling with three warm-up calls.
